links.outcome: Correlation of static benchmark performance with performance in interactive standardized patient scenarios
links.effect: Performance on static benchmarks does not reliably translate to SP scenarios; best model GPT-5.5 completes 60.4% of rubric items, best medical model 40.0%.
links.quote: Applying MedSP1000 to a range of general-purpose and medically specialized LLMs, we find that performance on static benchmarks does not reliably translate to such educational scenarios.

unlisted_practices: Standardized-patient-derived interactive multi-turn benchmark with trajectory-level rubrics for evaluating clinical agents
Effect of increased test-time compute on clinical agent performance

screen.reason: The study evaluates the dynamic clinical decision-making performance of LLM clinical agents using an interactive simulated benchmark based on standardized patient cases (MedSP1000) rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
